prompt: A single wide illustration depicts a towering software fortress whose architects stand proudly beside incomplete blueprints, unaware of a jagged unmapped crack in the wall through which shadowy attackers already slip; a giant clock overhead reads “0 DAYS.” Patient specialists with lanterns and magnifying glasses methodically search the masonry while a black-market stall nearby sells sealed envelopes of the secret.
